summary: JSON pretty printing is implemented but unverified: I did not run the tests, as instructed. Changes: rich/highlighter.py adds JSONHighlighter (base "json.", one combined pattern for brace, true/false/null, number, str); rich/default_styles.py adds the six json.* styles; rich/json.py (new) adds the JSON renderable and a main-guarded CLI (python -m rich.json PATH); rich/console.py adds Console.print_json after print; rich/__init__.py adds package-level print_json after print (__all__ unchanged); docs/source/console.rst gets a "Printing JSON" section, docs/source/reference/json.rst is new and linked from reference.rst; CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added entry; tests/test_json.py (new) covers styled output, the global function, and invalid JSON. Choices to check: the CLI imports Console (the spec's no-console-import rule applies to the renderable only); string matching allows escaped backslashes as pairs; overflow is set to Python None. The hand-derived ANSI escapes in the styled-output test are the most likely point of failure. No commits were made.
